title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2610.31633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. translated_title: BeNice！通过KV共享缩小循环架构的推理内存差距
translated_abstract: 循环架构通过反复将激活值传递经过同一层块，在保持参数量固定的同时提升模型质量。在推理过程中，每次递归都会生成独立的KV缓存，导致内存呈线性增长。为解决这一挑战，先前的工作提出了KV共享（即在深度方向上共享KV缓存），并发现在某些情况下，最后一次递归的KV缓存可以与较早的递归共享而不会造成质量损失，我们将这一特性称为KV可共享性。然而，KV可共享性背后的机制仍然知之甚少，即使是训练方式完全相同的循环架构也不能一致地展现这一特性。本文研究了如何在循环模型中实现KV可共享性。我们提出了一种两阶段方法：在第一阶段，我们在预训练期间使用随机深度，这会诱导收缩残差动力学，使表示在各次递归间趋向一个共同的极限……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段训练方法，通过在预训练中使用随机深度诱导收缩残差动力学，使循环架构实现KV缓存跨递归共享，从而将推理内存从线性增长降为常数而不损失模型质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage method using stochastic depth during pretraining to induce contractive residual dynamics, enabling KV-shareability in looped architectures and reducing inference memory from linear growth to constant without quality loss.
